blurb:
Cruise Passenger-Friendly – Direct Port Pick-Up at San Pedro

If you’re docking at the Port of Los Angeles in San Pedro, our tour is the ideal shore excursion. We offer direct pick-up and drop-off at the cruise terminal, allowing you to skip the crowds and dive straight into a luxury sightseeing experience. With onboard multimedia entertainment and secure luggage holding, our tour ensures cruise passengers enjoy the very best of Los Angeles with plenty of time to return to port before departure. It’s a seamless, fun, and efficient way to make the most of your time on land.

Tour Highlights Include:
 • Hollywood Sign (taking photos of the sign from our secret location)
 • Hollywood Walk of Fame
 • TCL Chinese Theatre
 • Beverly Hills & Rodeo Drive
 • Sunset Strip
 • Downtown Los Angeles
 • Walt Disney Concert Hall
 • Angelino Heights Victorian District
 • LA City Hall & more!
Dropping off at LAX or other hotels after the tour are also available.
